title: Seacrest Serenity Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of 30A, this exquisite beach house offers the ultimate coastal retreat, combining luxury and comfort in every detail. With five beautifully appointed bedrooms and four-and-a-half modern bathrooms, the home easily accommodates up to 14 guests, making it perfect for family gatherings or a getaway with friends. The open living area, complete with a view of the private, heated pool, invites relaxation and entertainment, while the large kitchen and dining area provide ample space for culinary delights and shared meals. Pet-friendly and just 0.25 miles from the beach, this house ensures your furry friends enjoy the vacation as much as you do. The outdoor space is a private haven, featuring a spacious fenced backyard perfect for pets and a heated saltwater pool surrounded by lush landscaping. Guests can unwind on the covered patio with comfortable seating, or explore the neighborhood using the included six-seater golf cart and bikes. Modern conveniences such as high-speed Wi-Fi, a bunk room for kids, and a flex living space enhance your stay, making this beach house not just a place to stay, but a destination for creating unforgettable memories.
rooms_guidance: Bunk Room: Single Over Single Bunk + Daybed + Trundle
